g.text: SGC-H/I/S/E -> local ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source and native gates OPEN

text.tspan: requester-entry
Processor-1 allocating request raises VM sync
interrupt and executes selected operation loop; locks
needed by that loop are released before join
peer-service
Other processors enter service_sync_op; nonzero
processor keeps servicing even after Scheme run
returns
old-roster
Tree captures current processor_count; resize nested
GC happens before target membership commit; root-ready
does not authorize excluding processor one
flag-reset
First selected round resets sync-op flag
synchronously; later NOOP is needed before loop exit
rc-payload
VM root adapter must scan processor-1
RC/provisional/error slots while owner executes
selected GC; legacy processor-zero RC scan still needs
replacement
loop-result
Winning or combined request receives result and clears
local request; callback return alone does not permit
owner resume
owner-restore
After loop exit validate VM/PSTATE generation and
reload moved roots; processor-zero deferred error may
unwind instead of normal return
guard-error
Stable guard preserves original error and catcher
destination through marker cleanup; exception data is
handed to rooted VM outcome storage
procedural-cleanup
cleanup_interrupts_pstate releases procedural
interrupt queue; it does not itself demonstrate that
all sync/GC facilities were disabled
foreign-and-rc
free_still_objs may call release_foreign before bulk
RC cleanup; arbitrary foreign effects must close or
transfer while old owner still serviceable
topology-tail
Message publication unlocks before signal tail; common
roster result and old sender lifetime are separate
from worker receipt or join
global-cleanup
Live shrink, unactivated rollback, global shutdown and
cleanup_mem_vmstate wrapper need distinct permissions;
VM wrapper destroys scan facilities before processor-
zero memory cleanup, requiring whole-VM preflight
ready-but-participating
Ready frame and stopped mutator remain attached to old
VM roster and service sync-op; Scheme return does not
remove the processor
loop-return
First reset, selected operation disposition and
pending request result settle before final NOOP;
resize-internal GC does not consume pending GC, and
reload follows the latest epoch
guard-outcome
Guard catches admitted unwind, preserves primary
payload/destination, invalidates owned marker and
hands rooted outcome to VM custodian; cleanup error
cannot overwrite primary unwind
exit-preflight
Before roster commit or teardown admission closes,
drain guard/readers/pins/foreign producers under old
serviceable roster; only acknowledged storage move
permits retirement
topology-and-reuse
All participants use one effective topology result;
publication acceptance is separate from sender
tails/retained convergence; unknown OS join never
permits PSTATE generation reuse
ready-to-dispatch
Stopped mutator retains dispatcher service and old
roster identity; OS sleep without service is rejected
gc-to-noop
Return of garbage_collect_pstate precedes request
result/NOOP loop completion; owner root reload follows
loop return
catcher-and-marker
Restore old catcher and invalidate only initialized
marker; completion guard records primary outcome
before propagation
outcome-and-root
VM custodian accepts rooted error/result and remaining
resources before guard frame withdrawal; pin/readers
may delay storage free after rethrow
storage-and-foreign
Acknowledge native storage ownership and foreign
producer closure before topological removal; lost
reply does not grant cleanup permission
tree-and-admission
All participants observe effective roster; sender
tails and retained convergence precede teardown; no
local target-count veto after commit
exit-and-generation
Owner may free only inert remainder; observed known
join permits OS/PSTATE generation reuse,
ignored/unknown join does not
service-reuse
Reuse current service_sync_op/selected operation and
existing NOOP exit only after source refinement; no
assumption that root-ready means arbitrary native
blocking is legal
guard-reuse
Reuse runtime catcher mechanism with explicit guards;
all supported nonlocal exits must reach the contract
retirement
Added O(P) acknowledgement/domain bookkeeping may
reuse existing rounds only if qualified; no measured
speedup or zero-cost topology change is claimed
